subject: Next steps: 30-minute product walkthrough — Verde Health
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@verdehealth.io>, Tom Brewer <t.brewer@verdehealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: 30-minute product walkthrough — Verde Health

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Great conversation this morning — thanks for sharing the background on Verde's patient routing flows and the latency targets you mentioned. Quick recap from our side so we’re aligned before scheduling the demo: 

- Goal: evaluate Redwood Inference for low-latency, on-prem inference for clinical routing and summary generation.
- Success criteria you flagged: <10 token latency for short summaries, role-based data partitions, SOC 2 evidence for audit.
- Integrations to consider: Epic FHIR export, SFTP batch for nightly jobs.

We’d like to run a 30-minute product walkthrough (high level + quick infra Q&A). Please pick the best 30-minute slot from these options (all PT):

1) Tues, May 19 — 11:00–11:30 AM PT
2) Wed, May 20 — 08:30–09:00 AM PT
3) Thu, May 21 — 03:00–03:30 PM PT

If none of these work, tell me a couple of windows that do. Also, please let us know who from Verde should attend (security, infra, PM). I’ve attached a short mutual action plan and a 30-minute agenda.

Attachments: Verde-MAP-HighLevel.pdf, 30min-agenda.docx

Thanks — looking forward to taking this to the demo stage.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference — Production-grade inference for teams

Date: Fri, 14 May 2026 11:03:12 -0700

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. Option 1 (Tue, May 19 at 11:00 AM PT) looks good for us. I’ll be there, and I’ve looped in Tom (security lead) to the thread — he should join the call as well.

Quick ask before the walkthrough: can you include a 5-minute section on our compliance needs (SOC2 scope + encryption at rest)? Also — we'll want the session recorded.

Perfect — locking Tue 19 May, 11:00–11:30 AM PT. I’ll send a calendar invite with a Zoom link.

Agenda update: we’ll add a 5-min compliance/controls callout (Tom) and leave 10 minutes for infra questions. Ben (CC’d) will run the infra portion; Priyom (cc’d) will join for the rollout/contract Q&A at a high level.

Pre-demo asks (small favors so we can tailor the session):
- If possible, can you share a short sample HL7/FHIR fixture or a sanitized export we can use as an example? (SFTP/CSV is fine)
- Any high-level constraints on data residency we should know about?

Calendar invite: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/abcd-1234 (ics attached)
Attachments: calendar-invite.ics

See you Tuesday — we’ll follow up with a brief prep note 24 hours before the call.

—Marissa
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Tom Brewer <t.brewer@verdehealth.io>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2026 08:09:30 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps: 30-minute product walkthrough — Verde Health

Hi Samantha —

Quick note on the technical side so we make the 10-minute infra Q&A productive:
- I’ll prepare a one-slide diagram showing how our VPC/private deployment would sit alongside your Epic environment.
- If you can share an anonymized FHIR sample (one patient, ~10 records), we'll demonstrate end-to-end parsing and a sample inference call.
- We'll include expected latency numbers on the slide (p95 for short prompts).

If you prefer not to share data before the meeting, no problem — we’ll use a synthetic example.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter | Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks — we can share a redacted FHIR extract prior to the call. I’ll have our data engineer export a single-patient sample and send it to Marissa via SFTP (credentials to follow). Attendees for Tue: Samantha Lee (ops), Tom Brewer (security), Jerome Park (infra) — Jerome will be the technical SME.

Please include the short slide on architecture + p95 numbers as discussed. Looking forward to Tuesday.

Best,
Samantha
